authorization_scope: Draft recommended exact IDs for AppWorld14, TUA10, AssistantBench8 and GPQA12 from named v1 candidate pools. No roster selection or source acquisition is authorized by this file.

method.name: Minimum-one proportional stratification with stable SHA-256 ranking
steps: Use every ID from the named v1 pool once. Group on existing descriptive labels only; do not consult scores, pass rates, refusals or durations to rank candidates.

Guarantee one place to each nonempty group. Allocate the remaining places proportionally to each group's remaining capacity using exact rational arithmetic, largest remainders and ascending group name for ties.
For each raw task ID compute SHA256(UTF8(seed + NUL + family_id + NUL + task_id)). Rank ascending by hexadecimal digest, then raw task ID as a collision tie-breaker.
Recommend the first quota entries within each hash-ranked group. Display final recommendations in old roster order for traceability.
Keep all unchosen pool members visible. Treat every resulting ID as a review recommendation with source and native qualification still pending.
decision_inputs: AppWorld descriptive category and app count for coverage reporting
method.bias_note: This reduces analyst discretion within the frozen v1 pools. It does not undo any selection bias in those historical pools and does not make the chosen coarse groups statistically representative of the full upstream benchmarks.
